generate_mujoco_scene_xml: generate MuJoCo scene XML files from processed dataset data for robotic manipulation simulation
add_xyzrpy_actuators_to_xml: replace a MuJoCo free joint with six individual slide and hinge joints plus position actuators
format_float_for_mujoco: format a float value to six significant figures for MuJoCo XML attributes
configure_collision_pairs: configure hand-to-object, object-to-object, and hand-to-floor collision pairs with friction and solref settings
add_equality_constraints_to_scene: add equality constraints between track and reference sites to enforce spatial relationships in the MuJoCo model
